evidence.note: S383 tests the specific unapproved source-centered marker/full-text schedule candidate against actual S380 Polo rendering for all 17 options; no production change or face release.

text: S383 is a bounded diagnostic feasibility study of the proposed A/B/D–I source-centered keyed POM markers and complete full-text schedule across all 17 current Polo options. It preserves exact source POMs, anchors, geometry, the 0.25 cm gate, residual and all 34 holds; production implementation requires a later explicit approval.
